▲Takane＊＊▲！？
Hehe.

Gah!!

Welcome to the Land of Rabbits.
Whoa!? Ah... ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ What's with that outfit？

Eh？
This is the land where lonely rabbits live... I invited you here.

Of course not！
I'm glad. Then will you live with me？ Here, in the Land of Rabbits.
Yeah, of course.

Entry ceremony？
Yes. First, put your hands up on your head like rabbit ears？

What!?
Bunny hops, of course？
(I have to say, "Boku wa usagi no kuni no kokumin ni naru pyon！")
Boku wa usagi no kuni no kokumin ni naru pyon！ (I am a resident of the Land of Rabbits now！) Urgh...

I'm so happy. Now you're one of us. Then, here, this.

I-I'll eat it！
(Ugh... A whole raw carrot is tough...)

What are you saying？ Rabbits don't drink water, you know？
Hold on！ That's a myth！ Rabbits need water too！

(She ignored me...)

▲高嶺＊＊▲, I'll never make you lonely again！
